### Cause
In [errcatalog/warehouse.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/errcatalog/warehouse.go#L11), the error key `"warehouse.limit"` was incorrectly mapped to [`api.CodeInternal`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/api/errors.go#L13) instead of [`api.CodeQuota`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/api/errors.go#L12). Because [`api.HTTPStatus`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/api/errors.go#L18) maps `api.CodeQuota` to `http.StatusTooManyRequests` (429) and defaults other non-client codes to `http.StatusInternalServerError` (500), warehouse limit/capacity errors returned HTTP 500.

### Fix
- Updated [errcatalog/warehouse.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/errcatalog/warehouse.go#L11) to map `"warehouse.limit"` to [`api.CodeQuota`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/api/errors.go#L12), matching other service limit errors across the catalog.
- Added a test assertion in [errcatalog/catalog_test.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-3380602982/acap-bench-2293832321/errcatalog/catalog_test.go#L14-L16) to verify that `Status("warehouse.limit")` returns 429.

### Verification
Ran `go test ./...` and all 7 packages passed.
